adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the handler computes `uniqueGuests` by filtering out emails already in `booking.attendees` and blacklisted ones, but then calls `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` using the raw `guests` input instead of `uniqueGuests`.
